title: Wave Book Stand (reading easel)
description: Slanted reading easel with a rolling-wave top edge, page-holding ledge and open wave cut-outs; holds a cookbook, tablet or paperback upright.
use: Desk / kitchen book or tablet stand. Ledge holds up to ~28 mm thick books; wave arms hold pages open (keep a clip for thick books).
material: PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4 perimeters, 15% infill. No supports needed (back leans 20 degrees from vertical).
